# Value.Equals

```m
Value.Equals(value1 as any, value2 as any, optional precision as nullable number) as logical
```

Returns true if value `value1` is equal to value `value2`, false otherwise.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `value1` | `any` | no |
| `value2` | `any` | no |
| `precision` | `nullable number` | yes |
